prequestions.q: Why does rereading feel effective even when it isn't?

points.text: Rereading creates fluency, which feels like knowing

evidence.exact: Rereading, by contrast, creates fluency: the text feels familiar, and familiarity is easily mistaken for knowing.

points.text: Retrieval pulls information out of memory

evidence.exact: Retrieval practice is the act of pulling information out of memory rather than putting it back in.
